note: header navigation and controls -- renders: site logo, main menu, search button, user account links; excluding the search input query text
footer links and icons -- renders: privacy, about, disclaimers, contact, legal/safety, code of conduct, developers, stats, cookies, mobile view, copyright and powered by icons
appearance settings panel -- renders: custom font size, limited width, and skin theme radio options
page title bar and help indicator -- renders: page heading and help link
search results pager controls -- renders: results per page limit combo box and navigation buttons
skip link -- renders: skip to main content link
page tools dropdown -- renders: page options and tools controls
interwiki search results -- renders: links to other Wikimedia projects (Wikisource, Wikiquote, Wikibooks)
search results info -- renders: computed result count and status
search create link copy -- renders: operator-authored text for creating non-existent pages
